performance.verdict: CPL collapse is real; 5 overdue SOW milestones threaten the stay/walk decision.

findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue (oldest: 2026-07-23 renewal doc); dashboard, attribution gap, and CRM cleanup all missed August deadlines — scoreboard is untrusted.
CPL rose 82.85% in 7d on flat spend (+0.88%); last 3 days (Sep 8–10) yielded only 6 leads vs 10 in prior 3 days (Sep 5–7), confirming efficiency collapse, not noise.
Top campaign 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting' consumed $374.99 of $738.15 (28d) with leads declining sharply — retargeting audience exhaustion is the probable cause.
GBP actions fell 51.72% in 7d and show 0 actions for the last 4 days (Sep 7–10), moving opposite to what a healthy paid-to-organic halo would predict — organic floor is eroding.
GHL shows 101 opportunities created but 0 won and 0 appointments; 340 contacts vs 99 28d leads signals an intake processing gap, not an ads-volume problem.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; dashboard and attribution gap block the August scoreboard trusted by Sep 30.
suggestions.monday_update: Five SOW milestones are past due, the oldest dating to 2026-07-23; the dashboard (due 2026-08-31) and attribution gap (due 2026-08-07) are the most critical because the client's renewal decision depends on a trusted scoreboard. Nacer should assign owners and hard deadlines to all five items today. Success check: all 5 milestone items marked complete in Monday by 2026-09-19, dashboard live and confirmed with Sohib.

suggestions.text: Introduce at least 1 new creative into 'BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting'; CPL up 82.85% on a campaign consuming $374.99 of 28d spend.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS retargeting campaign held $374.99 of the last 28-day spend while CPL jumped 82.85% week-over-week; the 3-day lead count (Sep 8–10) fell to 6 vs 10 in the prior 3 days, confirming audience fatigue. Swap in at least one new creative variant (different hook or offer framing) while holding the existing budget level — do not scale until CPL returns below the 28-day average of $7.46. Re-evaluate CPL on 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow: 101 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirm Lily or new hire is actioning leads within 24h.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 101 opportunities created against 340 contacts with zero won and zero appointments logged in the 28-day window; this is an intake processing gap, not an ads problem. Confirm with Lily and the new intake hire that all inbound leads are being contacted within 24 hours and that appointment outcomes are being recorded in GHL. Success check: at least 5 appointments logged in GHL by 2026-09-18, confirming the pipeline is moving.
